root_idea.summary: The supplied evidence centers on a harsh or ill-natured disposition that manifests in contentious, oppositional behavior.
root_idea.development: The lexical pattern extends from being refractory or ill-natured to treating others harshly and disagreeing or contending reciprocally; the Quranic participle presents this as mutual quarrelling.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular active-participle citation form.

senses.definition: Mutually contentious, disagreeing, or quarreling, and behaving toward one another harshly because of ill nature.
senses.usage_conditions: Plural active participle in the reciprocal Form VI pattern; in the Quranic construction, the parties are characterized by mutual dispute and harsh conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be refractory, untractable, perverse, stubborn, or obstinate in disposition; to be hard or ill-natured in behavior or dealings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verb; the vocalic variant شَكُسَ is also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat or behave toward someone with hardness, harshness, or ill nature.
To treat one another harshly or contentiously; to disagree or oppose one another, including in buying and selling; figuratively, of night and day, to stand opposed or alternate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reciprocal Form VI construction; the night-and-day usage is explicitly figurative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A narrow or confined place of alighting or abode.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended nominal expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The day or two before the new moon; the interval called المُحَاقُ.
Refractory, untractable, perverse, stubborn, obstinate, hard in disposition, or ill-natured.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective or epithet; the plural شُكْسٌ is reported, along with vocalic variants.
An explicitly marked figurative extension of the adjective.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form I disposition and behavior meaning.
Reciprocal harshness, disagreement, opposition, and related figurative usage.
Narrow place of alighting or abode.

cautions: The supplied Quran occurrence is the plural active participle مُتَشَاكِسُونَ; the public headword is normalized to the singular citation form مُتَشَاكِسٌ.
